title: Paneer Bhurji
ingredients: ["200 g paneer (crumbled)", "80 g onion (finely chopped)", "100 g tomato (chopped)", "5 g green chilli (chopped)", "5 g ginger (grated)", "10 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g garam masala", "2 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Heat oil in a pan and saute onion until soft.", "Add ginger, green chilli and tomato; cook until the tomato breaks down.", "Stir in turmeric, garam masala and salt.", "Add crumbled paneer and cook for 3-4 minutes.", "Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot."]

title: Egg Bhurji
ingredients: ["200 g eggs (4 large)", "60 g onion (chopped)", "80 g tomato (chopped)", "5 g green chilli (chopped)", "10 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Heat oil and saute onion and green chilli.", "Add tomato, turmeric and salt; cook for 2 minutes.", "Pour in beaten eggs and scramble on low heat until just set.", "Garnish with coriander leaves."]

title: Dal Tadka
ingredients: ["100 g toor dal (rinsed)", "500 ml water", "50 g onion (chopped)", "80 g tomato (chopped)", "6 g garlic (chopped)", "2 g cumin seeds", "10 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g red chilli powder", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Pressure-cook dal with water and turmeric for 3-4 whistles until soft.", "Heat oil, add cumin seeds and garlic until fragrant.", "Add onion, then tomato and chilli powder; cook until soft.", "Pour the tempering into the dal, add salt and simmer for 5 minutes."]

title: Chana Masala
ingredients: ["150 g chickpeas (dried, soaked overnight)", "100 g onion (chopped)", "150 g tomato (pureed)", "8 g ginger (grated)", "8 g garlic (minced)", "15 g oil", "4 g chana masala powder", "3 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves"]
directions: ["Pressure-cook soaked chickpeas until tender.", "Heat oil and saute onion, ginger and garlic until golden.", "Add tomato puree and chana masala; cook until oil separates.", "Add chickpeas with some cooking water and salt; simmer 10 minutes.", "Garnish with coriander leaves."]

title: Rajma Masala
ingredients: ["150 g rajma (dried, soaked at least 8 hours)", "100 g onion (chopped)", "150 g tomato (pureed)", "8 g ginger (grated)", "8 g garlic (minced)", "15 g oil", "3 g garam masala", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Drain soaked rajma and boil vigorously (pressure-cook) until completely soft.", "Heat oil and saute onion, ginger and garlic.", "Add tomato puree and garam masala; cook until thick.", "Add rajma with cooking liquid and salt; simmer 15 minutes."]

title: Palak Paneer
ingredients: ["250 g spinach (washed)", "150 g paneer (cubed)", "60 g onion (chopped)", "60 g tomato (chopped)", "6 g garlic", "5 g ginger", "10 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, cool and blend to a puree.", "Heat oil and saute onion, garlic and ginger.", "Add tomato and garam masala; cook until soft.", "Add spinach puree and salt; simmer 5 minutes.", "Add paneer cubes and cook 2 more minutes."]

title: Moong Dal Chilla
ingredients: ["100 g moong dal (soaked 3 hours)", "5 g ginger", "4 g green chilli", "40 g onion (finely chopped)", "8 g oil", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Grind soaked dal with ginger, green chilli and a little water to a smooth batter.", "Stir in onion and salt.", "Spread a ladle of batter on a hot oiled pan.", "Cook both sides until golden."]

title: Besan Chilla
ingredients: ["100 g besan", "40 g onion (chopped)", "40 g tomato (chopped)", "5 g coriander leaves", "8 g oil", "2 g salt", "120 ml water"]
directions: ["Whisk besan, water and salt into a smooth batter.", "Mix in onion, tomato and coriander leaves.", "Spread on a hot oiled pan and cook both sides until golden."]

title: Vegetable Poha
ingredients: ["100 g poha (rinsed)", "50 g onion (chopped)", "40 g peas", "20 g peanuts", "2 g curry leaves", "2 g mustard seeds", "10 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "10 g lemon (juice)", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Rinse poha and let it soften for 5 minutes.", "Heat oil, fry peanuts, then add mustard seeds and curry leaves.", "Add onion and peas; cook until soft.", "Add turmeric, salt and poha; mix gently and heat through.", "Finish with lemon juice."]

title: Vegetable Upma
ingredients: ["100 g suji", "50 g onion (chopped)", "40 g carrot (diced)", "30 g peas", "10 g oil", "2 g mustard seeds", "2 g curry leaves", "300 ml water", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Dry-roast suji until fragrant and set aside.", "Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves, then onion, carrot and peas.", "Add water and salt and bring to a boil.", "Slowly add suji while stirring; cook covered for 2-3 minutes."]

title: Masala Oats
ingredients: ["80 g oats", "40 g onion (chopped)", "50 g tomato (chopped)", "30 g carrot (grated)", "30 g peas", "5 g oil", "300 ml water", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat oil and saute onion, carrot and peas.", "Add tomato and salt; cook 2 minutes.", "Add oats and water; simmer until creamy."]

title: Egg Curry
ingredients: ["200 g eggs (4 large, hard-boiled)", "100 g onion (chopped)", "120 g tomato (pureed)", "5 g ginger", "5 g garlic", "15 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g red chilli powder", "2 g garam masala", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat oil and saute onion, ginger and garlic until golden.", "Add tomato puree and spices; cook until oil separates.", "Add a little water and salt to make a gravy.", "Add halved boiled eggs and simmer 5 minutes."]

title: Paneer Tikka
ingredients: ["250 g paneer (cubed)", "80 g curd", "80 g capsicum (cubed)", "60 g onion (cubed)", "10 g besan", "3 g red chilli powder", "2 g garam masala", "10 g lemon (juice)", "8 g oil", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Mix curd, besan, spices, lemon juice, oil and salt into a marinade.", "Coat paneer, capsicum and onion and rest for 20 minutes.", "Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-roast until charred at the edges."]

title: Curd Rice
ingredients: ["100 g rice", "200 g curd", "50 ml milk", "2 g mustard seeds", "2 g curry leaves", "4 g green chilli", "5 g oil", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Cook rice until very soft and let it cool.", "Mash lightly and mix with curd, milk and salt.", "Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves and green chilli in oil and pour over the rice."]

title: Jeera Rice
ingredients: ["150 g basmati rice (rinsed)", "10 g ghee", "3 g cumin seeds", "300 ml water", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat ghee and fry cumin seeds until they crackle.", "Add rice and stir for a minute.", "Add water and salt, cover and cook until the water is absorbed."]

title: Vegetable Pulao
ingredients: ["150 g basmati rice (rinsed)", "60 g carrot (diced)", "60 g peas", "50 g beans (chopped)", "50 g onion (sliced)", "10 g ghee", "2 g garam masala", "300 ml water", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat ghee and fry onion until light brown.", "Add vegetables and garam masala; stir 2 minutes.", "Add rice, water and salt; cover and cook until done."]

title: Aloo Gobi
ingredients: ["200 g potato (cubed)", "250 g cauliflower (florets)", "60 g onion (chopped)", "80 g tomato (chopped)", "15 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g cumin seeds", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat oil and add cumin seeds, then onion.", "Add potato and cauliflower with turmeric and salt.", "Cover and cook on low heat until tender, stirring occasionally.", "Add tomato and cook 5 more minutes."]

title: Bhindi Masala
ingredients: ["250 g okra (sliced)", "80 g onion (sliced)", "60 g tomato (chopped)", "15 g oil", "2 g red chilli powder", "2 g coriander powder", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat oil and cook okra uncovered until no longer sticky; set aside.", "Saute onion, then tomato and spices.", "Add okra back with salt and cook 5 minutes."]

title: Baingan Bharta
ingredients: ["400 g brinjal (1 large)", "80 g onion (chopped)", "100 g tomato (chopped)", "6 g garlic (minced)", "10 g oil", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Roast brinjal over a flame until the skin chars and the flesh is soft.", "Peel and mash the flesh.", "Saute garlic and onion in oil, add tomato and cook until soft.", "Add mashed brinjal and salt; cook 5 minutes."]

title: Masoor Dal
ingredients: ["100 g masoor dal (rinsed)", "450 ml water", "50 g onion (chopped)", "60 g tomato (chopped)", "5 g garlic", "8 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Simmer dal with water and turmeric until soft.", "Saute garlic, onion and tomato in oil.", "Combine with the dal, add salt and simmer 5 minutes."]

title: Moong Sprouts Salad
ingredients: ["150 g moong sprouts", "40 g onion (chopped)", "50 g tomato (chopped)", "60 g cucumber (chopped)", "10 g lemon (juice)", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Steam sprouts for 3-4 minutes if you prefer them softer.", "Toss all ingredients together and serve immediately."]

title: Chapati
ingredients: ["150 g atta", "90 ml water", "5 g oil", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Knead atta, salt, oil and water into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.", "Divide into 6 balls and roll into thin circles.", "Cook on a hot tawa, flipping, until puffed with light brown spots."]

title: Cucumber Raita
ingredients: ["250 g curd", "80 g cucumber (grated)", "30 g onion (finely chopped)", "1 g cumin powder (roasted)", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Whisk curd until smooth.", "Stir in cucumber, onion, cumin powder and salt.", "Chill before serving."]

title: Paneer Paratha
ingredients: ["150 g atta", "120 g paneer (grated)", "30 g onion (finely chopped)", "4 g green chilli", "15 g ghee", "2 g salt", "90 ml water"]
directions: ["Knead atta with water and a pinch of salt; rest 15 minutes.", "Mix paneer, onion, green chilli and salt for the filling.", "Stuff dough balls with filling and roll out gently.", "Cook on a tawa with ghee until golden on both sides."]

title: Masala Omelette
ingredients: ["150 g eggs (3 large)", "40 g onion (chopped)", "40 g tomato (chopped)", "3 g green chilli", "3 g coriander leaves", "8 g oil", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Beat eggs with salt and the chopped vegetables.", "Pour into a hot oiled pan and cook until set.", "Fold and serve."]

title: Soya Chunks Curry
ingredients: ["80 g soya chunks", "80 g onion (chopped)", "100 g tomato (pureed)", "12 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Boil soya chunks for 5 minutes, drain and squeeze out the water.", "Saute onion in oil, add tomato puree and garam masala.", "Add soya chunks, salt and a little water; simmer 10 minutes."]

title: Tofu Bhurji
ingredients: ["200 g tofu (crumbled)", "60 g onion (chopped)", "60 g tomato (chopped)", "4 g green chilli", "8 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Saute onion and green chilli in oil.", "Add tomato, turmeric and salt; cook 2 minutes.", "Add tofu and cook 4-5 minutes, stirring."]

title: Banana Oats Smoothie
ingredients: ["40 g oats", "120 g banana (1 medium)", "250 ml milk", "10 g almonds"]
directions: ["Blend all ingredients until smooth.", "Serve immediately."]

title: Vegetable Sambar
ingredients: ["80 g toor dal", "50 g carrot (chopped)", "60 g brinjal (chopped)", "50 g onion (chopped)", "60 g tomato (chopped)", "10 g tamarind (pulp)", "8 g sambar powder", "8 g oil", "2 g mustard seeds", "2 g curry leaves", "3 g salt", "600 ml water"]
directions: ["Pressure-cook dal until soft and mash.", "Boil vegetables with tamarind, sambar powder, salt and water until tender.", "Add dal and simmer 5 minutes.", "Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and pour over."]

title: Mushroom Matar
ingredients: ["200 g mushroom (sliced)", "100 g peas", "80 g onion (chopped)", "100 g tomato (pureed)", "12 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Saute onion in oil until golden.", "Add tomato puree and garam masala; cook until thick.", "Add mushroom and peas with salt; cook 8-10 minutes."]

title: Paneer Bhurji Toast
ingredients: ["120 g paneer (crumbled)", "60 g bread", "40 g onion (finely chopped)", "50 g tomato (chopped)", "5 g green chilli (chopped)", "8 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Heat oil and saute onion and green chilli until soft.", "Add tomato and turmeric; cook 2 minutes until it softens.", "Stir in crumbled paneer and salt; cook 3 minutes.", "Toast the bread and serve the bhurji on top with coriander leaves."]

title: Moong Dal Paneer Chilla
ingredients: ["140 g moong dal (soaked 3 hours)", "120 g paneer (crumbled)", "40 g onion (finely chopped)", "5 g ginger (grated)", "4 g green chilli (chopped)", "10 g oil", "2 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Drain the soaked dal and grind with ginger, green chilli and a little water to a batter.", "Stir in salt, onion and coriander leaves.", "Pour a ladle onto a hot non-stick pan and spread into a thin circle.", "Scatter crumbled paneer over one half, drizzle oil and cook 2-3 minutes per side.", "Fold and serve hot with chutney."]

title: Greek Yogurt Almond Bowl
ingredients: ["200 g greek yogurt", "20 g almonds (chopped)", "20 g oats", "80 g banana (sliced)", "10 g honey"]
directions: ["Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.", "Top with oats, banana and almonds.", "Drizzle honey over the top and serve cold."]

title: Masala Tofu Scramble
ingredients: ["150 g tofu (crumbled)", "40 g onion (chopped)", "40 g tomato (chopped)", "40 g capsicum (chopped)", "8 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "2 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Press the tofu for 10 minutes to remove water, then crumble it.", "Heat oil and saute onion and capsicum until soft.", "Add tomato, turmeric and salt; cook 2 minutes.", "Stir in the tofu and cook 4 minutes, then finish with coriander leaves."]

title: Peanut Butter Banana Oats
ingredients: ["50 g oats", "250 ml milk", "30 g peanut butter", "80 g banana (sliced)", "10 g flaxseed"]
directions: ["Simmer the oats in milk for 5 minutes, stirring.", "Take off the heat and stir in the peanut butter until smooth.", "Top with banana and flaxseed and serve warm."]

title: Soya Peanut Upma
ingredients: ["80 g soya chunks", "60 g suji", "30 g peanuts", "60 g onion (chopped)", "40 g carrot (chopped)", "10 g oil", "3 g mustard seeds", "5 g curry leaves", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Soak the soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes, squeeze dry and chop.", "Dry roast the suji until it smells nutty and set aside.", "Heat oil, crackle mustard seeds, add curry leaves, peanuts, onion and carrot.", "Add the soya chunks, 400 ml water and salt; bring to a boil.", "Stir in the suji slowly, cover and cook 5 minutes on low heat."]

title: Dahi Chana Bowl
ingredients: ["200 g greek yogurt", "60 g chickpeas (dried, soaked overnight and boiled)", "40 g cucumber (chopped)", "40 g tomato (chopped)", "10 g lemon (juice)", "1 g cumin", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Whisk the yogurt smooth with salt and roasted cumin.", "Fold in the boiled chickpeas, cucumber and tomato.", "Finish with lemon juice and serve cold."]

title: Egg Paneer Bhurji
ingredients: ["150 g egg (about 3, beaten)", "60 g paneer (crumbled)", "40 g onion (chopped)", "40 g tomato (chopped)", "8 g oil", "2 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Heat oil and saute onion until golden.", "Add tomato and salt; cook until soft.", "Pour in the beaten egg and stir constantly until just set.", "Fold in the paneer, cook 1 minute and finish with coriander leaves."]

title: Palak Tofu
ingredients: ["250 g tofu (cubed)", "300 g spinach (blanched)", "60 g onion (chopped)", "60 g tomato (chopped)", "8 g garlic (minced)", "5 g ginger (grated)", "12 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, cool and blend to a puree.", "Heat oil and saute onion, garlic and ginger until golden.", "Add tomato and cook until it breaks down.", "Stir in the spinach puree, garam masala and salt; simmer 5 minutes.", "Add the tofu cubes and simmer 5 minutes more."]

title: Rajma Chawal
ingredients: ["180 g rajma (dried, soaked 8 hours)", "150 g rice", "80 g onion (chopped)", "120 g tomato (pureed)", "8 g ginger (grated)", "8 g garlic (minced)", "15 g oil", "3 g garam masala", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Pressure cook the soaked rajma with salt until soft, about 25 minutes.", "Cook the rice separately.", "Heat oil and fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.", "Add the tomato puree and garam masala; cook until the oil separates.", "Add the cooked rajma with its water and simmer 10 minutes. Serve over rice."]

title: Soya Chunks Pulao
ingredients: ["100 g soya chunks", "150 g basmati rice", "80 g onion (sliced)", "60 g peas", "60 g carrot (diced)", "15 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Soak the soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes and squeeze dry.", "Heat oil and fry the onion until golden.", "Add carrot, peas, soya chunks, garam masala and salt; cook 3 minutes.", "Stir in the rinsed rice and 300 ml water.", "Cover and cook on low heat 15 minutes, then rest 5 minutes before serving."]

title: Paneer Tikka Masala
ingredients: ["250 g paneer (cubed)", "100 g curd", "120 g tomato (pureed)", "80 g onion (chopped)", "8 g ginger (grated)", "8 g garlic (minced)", "15 g oil", "3 g garam masala", "2 g red chilli powder", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Marinate the paneer in curd, half the garam masala and the chilli powder for 15 minutes.", "Sear the paneer in a hot pan until lightly charred and set aside.", "Heat oil and fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.", "Add the tomato puree, remaining garam masala and salt; cook until the oil separates.", "Return the paneer to the pan and simmer 5 minutes."]

title: Moong Dal Khichdi With Paneer
ingredients: ["100 g moong dal (rinsed)", "100 g rice", "100 g paneer (cubed)", "500 ml water", "10 g ghee", "1 g turmeric", "2 g cumin", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Heat ghee and crackle the cumin.", "Add the rinsed dal and rice with turmeric and salt; stir for a minute.", "Pour in the water, cover and cook 20 minutes until soft.", "Fold in the paneer cubes and rest 5 minutes before serving."]

title: Chole
ingredients: ["200 g chickpeas (dried, soaked overnight)", "80 g onion (chopped)", "120 g tomato (pureed)", "8 g ginger (grated)", "8 g garlic (minced)", "15 g oil", "3 g garam masala", "2 g coriander powder", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Pressure cook the soaked chickpeas with salt until tender, about 25 minutes.", "Heat oil and fry onion, ginger and garlic until deep golden.", "Add the tomato puree, garam masala and coriander powder; cook until the oil separates.", "Add the chickpeas with some of their water and simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few to thicken."]

title: Masoor Dal With Soya
ingredients: ["120 g masoor dal (rinsed)", "40 g soya chunks", "500 ml water", "60 g onion (chopped)", "80 g tomato (chopped)", "8 g garlic (chopped)", "10 g oil", "1 g turmeric", "3 g salt"]
directions: ["Soak the soya chunks in hot water 10 minutes, squeeze dry and chop small.", "Boil the dal with water, turmeric and salt until soft, about 20 minutes.", "Heat oil and fry garlic and onion until golden, then add tomato and cook down.", "Stir the tempering and the soya chunks into the dal and simmer 5 minutes."]

title: Tofu Chilli
ingredients: ["250 g tofu (cubed)", "100 g capsicum (cubed)", "80 g onion (cubed)", "15 g soy sauce", "8 g garlic (minced)", "5 g ginger (grated)", "12 g oil", "10 g spring onion (chopped)", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Press the tofu 10 minutes, cube it and pan fry in half the oil until golden. Set aside.", "Heat the rest of the oil and stir fry garlic, ginger, onion and capsicum on high heat.", "Add soy sauce and salt, then return the tofu and toss for 2 minutes.", "Finish with spring onion and serve hot."]

title: Paneer Tikka Skewers
ingredients: ["120 g paneer (cubed)", "50 g curd", "40 g capsicum (cubed)", "30 g onion (cubed)", "5 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Mix the curd with garam masala and salt and marinate the paneer 15 minutes.", "Thread paneer, capsicum and onion onto skewers.", "Grill or pan fry with oil until charred on all sides, about 8 minutes."]

title: Roasted Chana Peanut Mix
ingredients: ["60 g chickpeas (roasted)", "40 g peanuts (roasted)", "1 g red chilli powder", "1 g salt"]
directions: ["Warm the roasted chana and peanuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes.", "Toss with chilli powder and salt and cool before eating."]

title: Sprouts Chaat
ingredients: ["200 g moong sprouts (steamed)", "40 g onion (chopped)", "40 g tomato (chopped)", "10 g lemon (juice)", "1 g cumin", "1 g salt", "5 g coriander leaves (chopped)"]
directions: ["Steam the sprouts for 5 minutes and cool.", "Toss with onion, tomato, roasted cumin and salt.", "Finish with lemon juice and coriander leaves."]

title: Soya Kebab
ingredients: ["100 g soya chunks", "60 g potato (boiled)", "20 g besan", "40 g onion (finely chopped)", "10 g oil", "2 g garam masala", "2 g salt"]
directions: ["Soak the soya chunks in hot water 10 minutes, squeeze dry and grind coarsely.", "Mash the potato and mix with the soya, besan, onion, garam masala and salt.", "Shape into patties and shallow fry in oil 3 minutes per side until crisp."]
